utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces so far—do you know what they’re fixing first?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m not totally sure, but I’d guess they’re starting with the most urgent repairs first. I can check and help confirm the order if you want.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’d be great, thanks — I’m still hearing bits and pieces, so I’d like to know what they’re starting with first.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — send me the details and I’ll start reaching out to a few neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Mara — the repair drive is at the community center on Maple, just past the library. Take Oak over and turn right at the park.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Got it — I’ll start spreading the word and signing folks up. Thanks for the directions, Opal.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — I’ll bring the wrench and screwdriver for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Gus — that’d be a big help. Just let me know when you’re on your way.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Will do, Noah — I’ll head over when I’m on my way and keep you posted.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Vik—I appreciate it. Just send me the time and place again, and I’ll do my best to be there.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely—I’ll send the time and place again so it’s easy to follow, and I’ll keep sharing the plan too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Vik—that helps a lot. I’ll look out for your message and be there once I’ve got the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll check our supplies and let you know what we can spare.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you can spare enough for the repair drive, right?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes — I’ll confirm what we can spare and flag anything we’re short on.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll round up a few neighbors and swing by this afternoon with anyone who can help.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, thanks, Quinn — I’ll keep spreading the word while I’m out and watch for any update.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’ll keep inviting folks and I’ll let you know who’s coming by this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ve only got those two for now, but I’ll send more if I hear of any. What’s the biggest gap right now?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Mostly the timing and who’s coordinating it — I just want to know when to expect people and who I should check with.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Rosa’s coordinating it — I’ll check with her and send you the timing once I have it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It’s at the community center on Maple, just past the library, and the easiest route is Oak over to the park, then a right. If you want, I can also fill you in on what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, that helps. What still needs doing, and do we need to confirm the time or anything people should bring?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: We still need a few more hands for sorting and simple fixes, plus a table for tools if anyone has one. The time’s still set, and it’d help if people bring gloves and any extra tools they’re willing to lend.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Rey — I’m keeping the repair drive list up to date, so send me any homes that need help and I’ll add them right away.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Rosa — I’ll check with folks and send you any homes I hear about.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Tess. I appreciate you checking and letting me know as soon as you can.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’m on it — I’ll ask around about who’s coordinating and when they’re kicking things off. As soon as I hear something solid, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Tess — I appreciate you checking. Just let me know when you hear back.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely — I’ll ask around and pass along anything solid as soon as I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’ve got the gloves and flashlight covered—what’s the first thing you want me to help with when I get there?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Mina. First, let’s check the list together and then we’ll sort the repairs by priority.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sounds good—I'll meet you there and help sort the list by priority.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I’m still in for this week — just give me the quick time and place for setup and packing.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can handle setup and packing. Just send me the time and place, and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect — just send me the time and place, and I’ll be there for setup and packing.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll start inviting folks now and swing by this afternoon with whoever I can round up.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you’re actually available this week to help with the repair drive, right?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yep — I’m available this week and I’ll help round people up for the repair drive. I’ll keep you posted as I invite folks this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Any update on the repair drive yet? I’m out running errands, so I can pass it along if needed.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yes — I’m still spreading the word and I’ll send the time and place again so you can pass it along. We’re also keeping track of what supplies people can spare.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great — send me the time, place, and supply list, and I’ll pass it along while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Rey. Let’s keep it simple: I’ll bring the list, and we can make a clear plan from there.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That works for me — bring the list, and I’ll help sort out the next steps.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Rey — I appreciate it. I’ll keep everything organized and update the list as soon as you send them over.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes — let’s confirm the time, the drop-off spot, and what people should bring first.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely — I’ll confirm the time, the drop-off spot, and a short bring list so everyone has the details.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great — once you’ve got those, send them over and I’ll help double-check everything.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces so far—what are they fixing first?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m not totally sure yet — I just need the quick version. What’s the first repair they’re tackling?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces second-hand, so I’m still piecing it together. I’ll ask around and let you know what I find.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It’s at the community center on Maple, just past the library—take Oak over and turn right at the park.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it—community center on Maple, just past the library. I’ll tell everyone to bring any tools or parts they have.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, thanks, Dane — that’ll help a lot. I’ll keep folks posted and see you there.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. What did I miss?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Mostly just trying to pin down the timing and who’s coordinating it. If you hear anything solid, I’d really appreciate the update.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — I’ll keep an ear out and let you know if I hear the timing or who’s in charge.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Leo — the repair drive is at the community center on Maple, just past the library. Take Oak over and turn right at the park; that’s the easiest way there.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Opal — I’ll head that way now.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, Leo — let me know if you run into anything on the way.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Sam. I really appreciate you helping make the repair drive happen this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Of course — I’m on it. I’ll grab the repair kit from the community shed and bring it to the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thank you, Sam. I’ll be on the porch and ready when you get here.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’m still catching up from the grapevine, but I’m happy to help Saturday morning. What should I bring, and who’s the best person to check in with?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Bring gloves and a flashlight if you have them, and check in with Ira Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Got it — gloves and a flashlight, and I’ll check in with Ira Saturday morning. If I hear any fresh details before then, I’ll pass them along.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thanks, Cleo — I’m in, I just need the time and place again so I don’t mix them up. If you still need help sorting donations, I can do that too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Oren — I’ll check the time and place with Rosa and let you know. And yes, if you can help sort donations, that’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, thanks — just send it when you’ve got it, and I’ll be there to help sort the donations.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Mara — I’ll bring the tools for the repair drive. Just let me know what you need.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Gus — could you help spread the word and sign folks up? I’ll send you the details and start reaching out to a few neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely — I can help spread the word and sign folks up. Send me the details, and I’ll keep it simple.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
